Dying light is better in so many ways. You can craft anything, at any time, if you have the stuff for it. I found myself crafting and using things all the time because it was so convenient. Run into a bunch of zombies? Craft a bomb, craft some flaming shuriken, craft a distraction, etc. That alone makes it so much better. But, the movement system is also amazing. I know you said that you weren't a fan of Bioshock, but the best Single Player experience I've had with an FPS is still System Shock 2. Unreal Tournament is also good for twitch-style FPS arena shooters, and the AI is pretty good still. The Deus Ex series is good, except for Invisible War. The FEAR series can be good if you can get into the type of combat they use. Bulletstorm is great if you want to waste a few hours. Other than those, Borderlands 2 is a great kind of arcady game, as is STALKER in a more tactical type of way.

None of these are anything like Halo, because only series similar to Halo on the PC seems to be CoD:

Singularity is a weird combination of HL2 and Bioshock with time-traveling Russians. Very underrated game, for some reason everyone ignored it despite the fact it was decent with high production values.

Cryostasis is a survival horror FPS, except there's little survival, horror, or FPS in it. It's more of an adventure game with first person perspective and some shooting. Story a bit of the mindfuck side, but with a clear resolution(perhaps even too clear).

STALKER is three open world FPS games, all rather different to each other. Shadow of Chernobyl shines with the Complete mod which fixes bugs and improves AI. Clear Sky is best ignored. Call of Pripyat is great.

FEAR is a combination of FPS and horror, executing both very well. Even the story delivers. Avoid the sequel or expansion packs though.

Crysis, another underrated game, as most people never saw it as anything else but a tech demo for the Cryengine. Fun in Crysis largely relies on how much you want to fuck around with the AI using your suit powers and environment. If you just run through it shooting it can be pretty average, though even today(7 years after release!) it's still one of the best looking FPSes.
